summary: Completed frontend testing of redesigned toast notification system (sonner). Bottom toasts (VOILADI+, Boost error, Profile saved) work correctly with dark styling (#262626), positioned above tab bar, single toast visibility, and proper icons. Viewport scaling (393x660) maintains correct positioning. Realtime banner (WebSocket) requires manual verification due to timing constraints in automated testing.

integration_issues.issue: Banner with data-testid='toast-new-message' did not appear in automated test when message sent from Hana to Neo. WebSocket connection may have timing issues or message sent before connection established.
integration_issues.notes: Manual verification recommended: Send message to logged-in user from another account and verify banner appears at top with dark background, avatar, and navigates to chat on click. WebSocket URL: wss://match-fresh.preview.emergentagent.com/api/ws

passed_tests: Bottom toast (VOILADI+): Dark bar (#262626) appears at bottom, 15px above tab bar, white text, auto-dismisses in ~3s
No stacking: Only 1 toast visible when clicking multiple actions quickly (visibleToasts=1 working)
No white cards: No sonner default white backgrounds found (unstyled + custom classes working)
Error toast (Boost): Red icon (#ff6b6b), correct error message 'You can boost once a day. Come back later.'
Success toast (Profile saved): Check icon present, correct message 'Profile saved'
Viewport 393x660: Toast still positioned correctly above tab bar (28.7px gap) with fit-scale active
Regression: Discover swipe buttons (3 buttons), Likes page, Chat page, Settings page all functional
action_item_for_main_agent: Manual verification needed: Test realtime message banner by sending a message to a logged-in user from another account. Verify banner appears at top (<100px from top), has dark background (#262626), shows avatar + sender name + message text, and navigates to /chats/{id} on click. WebSocket connection timing may need adjustment if banner consistently fails to appear.
